releaseNotes:
• 🎦 Cinematic Video Player UI: Floating glassmorphic dock bar with Fit Screen, Tracks, 1.0x Speed, Sleep Timer, and Quality/HDR+ pills
• ⚡ Glowing Electric Cyan-Blue Seeker: Custom hardware-drawn progress line with halo thumb and live scrubbing preview
• 🔆 Left-Edge Vertical Brightness Line: Sleek glassmorphic vertical swipe HUD with sun icon and glowing blue line
• 🔊 Right-Edge Vertical Volume Line: Sleek glassmorphic vertical swipe HUD with speaker icon and glowing blue line
• 🌈 True HDR & HDR10+ Support: 10-bit BT.2020 wide color gamut, hardware-accelerated SurfaceView decoding, and Vivid Brightness Boost
• 🔄 Auto-Rotate on Click: Instantly plays in full-screen sensor landscape mode
• 🔒 Maximum Security Isolated Private Vault: Hidden from PC USB, file managers & media scanners
• 🗑️ Silent Clean Media Deletion without redundant system permission popups
